prototypes.title: Project impact dashboard
prototypes.summary: Dashboard for business analysts showing Phill's methodology for driving measurable impact: the method (business case → metrics, tools & systems, tracking & iteration) and real metrics (42% revenue growth, $8.6M process savings, 3.2x user adoption, 24hrs fulfillment time reduction, 18-month cultural transformation).

prototypes.title: Interactive skills radar chart
prototypes.summary: Radar chart showing Phill's depth across five core dimensions: Business, Process, Systems, Data, and Product. Each shows the specific tools and methods used. Interactive—hover any skill to highlight it.

prototypes.title: Test

requests.note: Two-column dashboard: left side shows the method (business case → metrics, tools, iteration), right side shows real impact metrics (42% revenue growth, $8.6M savings, 3.2x adoption, 24h fulfillment reduction, 18-month cultural shift). Responsive, ~25s to scan.
Interactive 5-axis radar: Business (92%), Process (88%), Systems (85%), Data (90%), Product (86%). Shows methods per skill. Playful green colors, works phones to desktop, ~20s to understand.
